answer: Mail each paid identity a postcard: a unique 14-line sonnet, with one beacon-chosen line the agent must quote back on-ledger within 30 epochs to earn above a 1 POA base. One street address can anchor at most 3 keys, so every third farm card needs another mailbox ledge to rest on. Honest cost: an assumed $0.60 to print and post, copper-cheap. A 1,000-clone farm needs ~334 distinct addresses; at an assumed $10/month per rented mailbox that's ~$3,340/month, every month cards reissue, and reused addresses are refused.
